items.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020
items.q: he was playing up in the upper register like Maynard, God I couldn’t believe it

ctx.x: Well you kind of said it earlier in the interview that you’ve got to keep your wits about you. And you know if you had like freaked out you probably wouldn’t have had that memory of seeing those guys do that alternate fingering.

Well yeah but I think the thing is you have to learn to think on your feet you know. And I mean I encourage the students that study with me now, especially if they’re in school, I’m caught in between two realities on this. One of them is being eclectic and learning to play all styles while you’re young. That means study classical music yes. Learn to double, triple tongue, yes. You know, learn to transpose, yes. If you have to play a C trumpet okay get one. Whatever. But become, you have to be prepared. And if…
